summary: Backend-only testing for Besord (FastAPI + MongoDB). Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ covering health, auth (negative cases + Mongo-injected positive flow), posts CRUD, vote increment/toggle/switch, word & image validation, and logout invalidation. 24/24 tests PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — consider switching to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, just a deprecation).
CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is technically rejected by browsers spec-wise; works for API testing but consider restricting origins for production.
WORD_RE allows accented Latin chars (À-ÿ) which is good for Portuguese; consider documenting this in the 400 error message which currently says 'apenas letras/números'.
Image validation only checks length>=50; no MIME / size cap — large base64 uploads could hit MongoDB 16MB doc limit. Consider adding an explicit max size check.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_ users + sessions directly into MongoDB (test_database) via pymongo and tear them down after the session. Test posts/votes created during runs are also cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) = https://image-feedback-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth is Emergent Google OAuth — cannot be programmatically obtained; use direct MongoDB injection of users + user_sessions (collection names exactly: 'users', 'user_sessions', 'posts', 'votes'). Bearer token = session_token field. Run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All requested endpoints behave as specified: health, auth negative cases return 401, public GET /api/posts works without auth (user_vote=null), authenticated CRUD + vote toggle/switch logic correct, word regex enforces letters/digits up to 20 chars, image_base64 must be >=50 chars, logout deletes session and subsequent /auth/me returns 401.
